trial_title: Use of Ibuprofen and Acetaminophen for Treatment of Acute Headache Post Concussion in Children
brief_summary: Concussions and headache are a significant problem for children and athletes. While headache generally resolves within 7-10 days; a significant proportion of children, 72-93% experience prolonged headache as a symptom of Post Concussion Syndrome (PCS). The prevailing clinical view is that mild head injuries resolve with little chance of complications. However, the reality is quite different. Concussion in children presents with a range of severity and results in both short and long-term physical
